task.title: Rename SWE-spawn gating hook to require-task-spec.sh; finalize regex for docs/trustmybot/tasks/*.{xml,md}
task.description:
Rename `scripts/hooks/require-task-xml.sh` to `scripts/hooks/require-task-spec.sh`. Inside the renamed hook, canonicalize the regex to match `docs/trustmybot/tasks/*.{xml,md}` only — drop legacy `bro/tasks/*.xml` support entirely. Add format-dispatched authorization checks: `.xml` files require `<authorized-by` + `status="open"`; `.md` files require frontmatter `authorized_by:` + `status: pending|open`.
Update `scripts/hooks/require-review-sign.sh` to scan the new directory for both extensions, and dispatch the unsigned check by extension (`<reviewed-by>`/`<closed-by>` for XML; frontmatter `reviewed_by:`/`closed_by:` for MD).
Update `hooks/hooks.json` line 35 to reference the renamed file.
BOOTSTRAP NOTE: The current `require-task-xml.sh` was patched in place to also accept the new `docs/trustmybot/tasks/*.md` path (frontmatter `authorized_by:` + `status: pending`) so this Phase 1 batch could be spawned. This task FINALIZES the hook by renaming the file, canonicalizing the regex, and removing the legacy `bro/tasks/*.xml` path support.
Use `git mv` to preserve history. Format dispatch logic (canonical body of the renamed hook):
```bash #!/usr/bin/env bash # Hook: Block SWE agent spawn unless prompt references a valid # docs/trustmybot/tasks/*.{xml,md} task spec. set -euo pipefail
INPUT=$(cat)
AGENT_TYPE=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.subagent_type // empty') PROMPT=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.prompt // empty')
[ "$AGENT_TYPE" != "swe" ] && exit 0
TASK_FILE=$(echo "$PROMPT" \ | grep -oE 'docs/trustmybot/tasks/[a-zA-Z0-9_.-]+\.(xml|md)' \ | head -1 || true)
if [ -z "$TASK_FILE" ]; then echo '{"decision":"block","reason":"BLOCKED: SWE requires a task spec at docs/trustmybot/tasks/*.{xml,md}. None found in prompt. Route through Architect to create a spec first."}' exit 0 fi
if [ ! -f "$TASK_FILE" ]; then echo "{\"decision\":\"block\",\"reason\":\"BLOCKED: Task spec $TASK_FILE does not exist. Architect must create it first.\"}" exit 0 fi
case "$TASK_FILE" in *.xml) if ! grep -q '<authorized-by' "$TASK_FILE" 2>/dev/null; then echo "{\"decision\":\"block\",\"reason\":\"BLOCKED: $TASK_FILE missing <authorized-by> tag.\"}" exit 0 fi if ! grep -q 'status="open"' "$TASK_FILE" 2>/dev/null; then echo "{\"decision\":\"block\",\"reason\":\"BLOCKED: $TASK_FILE status is not open.\"}" exit 0 fi ;; *.md) if ! grep -q '^authorized_by:' "$TASK_FILE" 2>/dev/null; then echo "{\"decision\":\"block\",\"reason\":\"BLOCKED: $TASK_FILE frontmatter missing authorized_by.\"}" exit 0 fi if ! grep -qE '^status:\s*(pending|open)' "$TASK_FILE" 2>/dev/null; then echo "{\"decision\":\"block\",\"reason\":\"BLOCKED: $TASK_FILE status is not pending or open.\"}" exit 0 fi ;; esac
exit 0 ```

files.file: Use `git mv` to preserve history. Then rewrite contents to the canonical body shown above. Drop ALL legacy `bro/tasks/*.xml` support. Keep file executable (`chmod +x`).

Change `[ -d "bro/tasks" ]` (line ~15) to `[ -d "docs/trustmybot/tasks" ]`. Change `for f in bro/tasks/*.xml` (line ~19) to `for f in docs/trustmybot/tasks/*.xml docs/trustmybot/tasks/*.md`. Inside the loop, dispatch the unsigned check by extension: - `.xml`: existing logic — has `<authorized-by>` but missing `<reviewed-by>`/`<closed-by>`. - `.md`: has frontmatter `authorized_by:` but missing `reviewed_by:` and missing `closed_by:`. Drop legacy `bro/tasks` path entirely.

task.commit:
🔧 refactor(hooks): rename require-task-xml.sh → require-task-spec.sh, finalize docs/trustmybot/tasks/*.{xml,md} regex
Drops legacy bro/tasks/*.xml support entirely. Adds format-dispatched authorization checks: .xml requires <authorized-by> + status="open"; .md requires frontmatter authorized_by: + status: pending|open. Updates require-review-sign.sh to iterate both extensions with per-extension dispatch (XML <reviewed-by>/<closed-by> vs MD frontmatter reviewed_by:/closed_by:). Updates hooks/hooks.json to point at the renamed script.
